name: DataRow
tiny_example: <DataRow id={item.id} title={item.title} actions={<ActionButton label="Edit" onAction={() => edit(item.id)} variant="ghost" />} />
use_when: single entity row in a list with optional actions
constraints: Pass stable string id for test targeting.
Put buttons in actions slot — do not nest custom flex layouts around the row.
test_hint: within listitem, getByText(title); action buttons by accessible name.
